meeting_scene:
As Priya stood up to address the team meeting, her warm smile and bright eyes commanded attention from everyone in attendance. "I think we're all feeling pretty good as a group today," she said with confidence, causing Sam's gaze wander slightly before he quickly refocused on his own hands clasped together.

Meanwhile, Jordan was scribbling some notes during Priya's statement, the corners of her mouth curving ever so slightly upwards at an invisible joke only she had understood. Alex spoke up next, their usually quiet demeanor momentarily giving way to a hint of nervousness as they hesitated before beginning a discussion about potential new projects.

As Vikram stood and began speaking with enthusiasm on one of his latest innovations - though he didn't seem too concerned that it would require working long overtime hours - Riya quietly nodded along at him, maintaining her serene demeanor but sending out subtle signals to Alex through their rapid-fire nods.
